title: Cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation: a falsification-grade research programme (Shroedinger, gen4)
description:
v6.5 — article 1 revised after peer review (Izvestiya RAN, Ser. Geogr.): spherical vorticity, 850 hPa below-surface mask, full recomputation (definition V12), manuscript v8.

  • manuscript_v2/article1/article1_v8.pdf / .docx (source article1_v8_src.tex), supplement article1_v8_supplement.pdf, five new figures (figures/v8/), journal package with the point-by-point reviewer response.
  • Phase 32 (docs/PROTOCOL_PHASE32_REVIEW_CHECKS.md): the relative vorticity now includes the metric term u tan(phi)/a; grid points where the 850 hPa surface lies below the terrain (ERA5 surface height above 1457 m) are excluded from smoothing (normalised convolution) and from the rank correlations; MERRA-2 below-surface fill values are no longer zero-filled. Checks: steps 2–5 without the grid-artefact pair, permutations within season/year/period strata, variance components (ICC), block bootstrap over longitude sectors, bootstrap intervals (experiment_B32_review_checks.py, experiment_B32_vorticity_mask.py).
  • All article-1 quantities recomputed under V12 by re-running Phases 2/2b/3/13/18 through experiment_B33_v12_recompute.py; results in clean_experiments/results/*_v12/; old-vs-new table in experiment_B32_review_checks/table2_compare.md. No qualitative conclusion changed; two numbers of the submitted Table 2 were found wrong (row 7 referred to steps 3–5; row 2 was not reproducible) and the “beyond-spectrum” rows were dropped as unstable.
  • reproducibility/article1_README.md section 0: route and SHA-256 of the v8 artifacts; reproduce_article1.py --stage check now fails on missing or mismatching hashes.

Raw ERA5 / MERRA-2 / HighResMIP fields are not stored; download scripts and all derived tables are included.
notes: Supersedes release v6.4. Article 1 revised after review: spherical vorticity, 850 hPa mask, definition V12, all article-1 numbers recomputed; papers 2–3 unchanged.
